text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"—Hello, Mother? 
Good day to you, it is Daring Tact. 
By the way... how are you feeling?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"The weather has been rather rough over 
there lately, hasn't it? 
I was worried you might have caught a 
cold. 
...I see. Hehe, that is such a relief."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...Me? 
I am working hard alongside Trainer every 
day. 
In fact, I'm in top condition on the path 
toward my dream!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, academy life is wonderful, too. 
Lately, Daring Heart has been teaching me 
how to sing. 
From upbeat pop tunes to calming jazz—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"I will be sure to sing for you when I 
visit next time, 
so please look forward to it! —Until then, 
farewell."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
All right... I'll give it my all today, 
too.
